title: 第3章 能力第4章 家族第5章 计划
slug: 异界冒险从组建冒险团开始
content_zh:
“靠！”
哗啦啦～
沃尔猛然从浴桶中起身，将隔壁的大爷吓了一跳，引来一阵怒目。
不过在看到沃尔那粗壮的臂膀，强壮的胸肌，以及棱角分明的腹肌后，又将即将出口的脏话咽了回去。
沃尔祖上阔过，身具有一部分帝国贵族血脉，二十岁的他看起来面色仍有些年幼，银灰色的头发加上尖尖的长耳朵，还有那明亮的大眼睛，湿漉漉的样子，看起来甚至有点柔弱。
但他身上苦练而来的大块肌肉弥补了这一部分。
沃尔眉头微皱扫视全场，其他人赶紧移开目光，但他并没有发现刚才那声音的来源。
“幻觉？恶魔的把戏？或者说……是神明赐福？”
不过那选择题似乎只有他能看见，而且周围的人对那激烈的金铁交击声也并没有反应。
思索了一下，那源于意识中的画面仍然未曾消散，沃尔也没有兴致再泡澡，按耐住心中激动，匆匆搓洗几下，便穿上短衫布衣和拖鞋，大步返回家中。
而在他家门口，一个瘦削精干的年轻人正百无聊赖地左顾右盼，见沃尔回来，赶忙露出笑脸：
“尊敬的沃尔先生，这是您订的豪华肉排餐。”
说着，他将手中大木盒递上：
“您享用完后，将厨具和木盒放在门口，我们就会回收清洗。”
看着对方的笑容，沃尔接过木盒，抬手让他等待一会，这才回家将藏起来的零钱取出，取出一枚铜币作为小费。
铜币的价值并不低，一枚就能在酒馆吃上一顿最便宜的豆子汤，足以填饱一个成年男人的肚子。
侍者的笑容更加真诚，取下帽子放在胸口道：
“感谢您的慷慨，祝您用餐愉快！”
如果是平时，沃尔可能会聊上几句，但他现在没这个心思，打发走侍者后，便锁上门，准备研究一下自己脑袋里的东西。
不过他也没忘了自己的好兄弟。

“青狼，来，吃吧。”
打开木盒，一股浓郁的肉香飘出，让青狼开始摇动它的大尾巴。
价值半个小银月，也就是5个铜币的餐食很是丰富，一大块淋上酱汁的肉排，上面点缀着香料和水果，旁边还有一片煎蛋和几片熏肉，以及一些绿色蔬菜。
主食是土豆泥，是冒险时吃的硬面包完全不能比拟的。
沃尔虽然饥饿，却无心享用美食，只是取出一份放在矮桌上，让青狼先行享用，自己则跑到楼上卧室，盘坐在床，研究起自己脑袋里的选择题。
【你选择在____岁开始外出冒险】
〖20〗
〖30〗
〖40〗
……
“这似乎和很久以前玩过的一款游戏有些类似。”
遥远的记忆从脑海中翻出，沃尔逐渐明白了状况。
“如果是我想的那样，以越大的年龄作为起始点，开局就能获得越多的点数。”
沃尔看着自己的手掌，宽厚有力，骨节粗大，覆盖着一层看似轻薄，实则坚韧耐磨的茧子。
“但我可不想再等二十年！”
随着沃尔意念集中，战旗上的文字发生改变。
【你选择在二十岁开始外出冒险！】
刺啦——
伴随着一阵刀剑出鞘声，金红色战旗飘动起来，上面的文字变幻：
【个人】【部队】【家族】

与此同时，沃尔也得到了一些信息，明白了该如何使用这面“战旗”。
“战争神器，还给予了我第二次生命……”
content_en:
"Fuck!"
Wow~
Wall suddenly stood up from the bathtub, startling the man next door and drawing an angry look.
But after seeing Wall's thick arms, strong chest muscles, and angular abdominal muscles, he swallowed back the curse words he was about to say.
Vol's ancestry was rich and he was part of the imperial aristocracy. At twenty years old, he still looked a little young. His silver-gray hair, long pointed ears, and big, bright eyes were wet, and he even looked a little weak.
But the bulk of his hard-earned muscles made up for it.
Wall frowned slightly and scanned the audience. Others quickly looked away, but he did not find the source of the sound just now.
"Illusion? A trick of the devil? Or...a blessing from the gods?"
However, it seemed that only he could see the multiple-choice question, and the people around him did not react to the fierce sound of gold and iron clashing.
After thinking about it for a while, the image from his consciousness still hadn't dissipated, and Wall was not interested in taking a bath anymore. He suppressed the excitement in his heart, washed himself a few times, put on a short shirt and slippers, and strode back home.
At the door of his house, a thin and capable young man was looking around boredly. When he saw Wall coming back, he quickly smiled:
"Dear Mr. Wall, this is the luxurious steak meal you ordered."
As he spoke, he handed over the big wooden box in his hand:
“After you have finished enjoying, leave the kitchen utensils and wooden boxes at the door and we will recycle and clean them.”
Seeing the other person's smile, Wall took the wooden box and raised his hand to ask him to wait for a while. Then he went home and took out the hidden change and took out a copper coin as a tip.
The value of copper coins is not low. One can buy the cheapest bean soup in a tavern, which is enough to fill the stomach of an adult man.
The waiter's smile became more sincere, he took off his hat and put it on his chest and said:
“Thank you for your generosity and enjoy your meal!”
If it were normal times, Wall might have a few words, but he didn't have the intention now. After sending the waiter away, he locked the door and prepared to study what was in his head.
But he didn't forget his good brother.
"Green Wolf, come on, eat."
Opening the wooden box, a strong aroma of meat wafted out, causing the green wolf to start wagging its big tail.
The meal worth half a small silver moon, which is 5 copper coins, is very rich, including a large piece of meat steak topped with sauce, dotted with spices and fruits, and beside it is a slice of fried egg, a few slices of bacon, and some green vegetables.
The staple food is mashed potatoes, which are completely incomparable to the hard bread eaten on adventures.
Although Wall was hungry, he had no intention of enjoying the food. He just took out a portion and placed it on the low table for Green Wolf to enjoy first. He ran to the bedroom upstairs, sat cross-legged on the bed, and studied the multiple-choice questions in his head.
[You choose to start venturing out at the age of ____]
〖20〗
〖30〗
〖40〗
…
"This seems similar to a game I played a long time ago."
Distant memories came out of his mind, and Wall gradually understood the situation.
"If it's what I think, if you start with an older age, you'll get more points at the beginning."
Wall looked at his palm. It was broad and powerful, with thick joints, and was covered with a layer of cocoon that seemed thin but was actually tough and wear-resistant.
"But I don't want to wait another twenty years!"
As Wall concentrated his thoughts, the words on the battle flag changed.
[You choose to start venturing out at the age of twenty! 】
Stab——
Along with the sound of swords being unsheathed, the golden-red war flag fluttered, and the words on it changed:
【Individual】【Troop】【Family】
At the same time, Wall also got some information and understood how to use this "battle flag."
"The artifact of war also gave me a second life..."
